message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Defendant driving a loader (铲车) at a construction site, while reversing, negligently hits a person on an electric bike, causing death. This is a traffic accident caused by negligence. The appropriate crime is "交通肇事罪" (dangerous driving causing death) but the label list includes "危险驾驶" (dangerous driving) as a label. However the correction lessons mention "危险驾驶;单位受贿" etc. So "危险驾驶" is used for dangerous driving (traffic accidents). Also there is "重大责任事故" for safety production accidents, but this is a traffic accident, not a production accident. So likely "危险驾驶". Could also be "过失致人死亡" but not in list. The list includes "故意伤害", "聚众斗殴", etc. The appropriate label is "危险驾驶". The fact says "因疏忽大意" which is negligence, not intentional. So "危险驾驶" is correct.

Check if any other label needed: maybe "过失致人死亡" not in list. So just "危险驾驶". Provide JSON with reasoning and final answer.
